_doc: Config for scripts/models/process.py. Material patterns are case-insensitive regexes on part names; first match wins. Colours are placeholders (Ansh: tune with lighting later). Known gap: the STEP lacks the PCB pads, part of the PCB, 0402 R/C, VL53L1X and JST bodies (Fusion mesh bodies) - used as-is for now. The IMU is tiny (33 mm), so the mat LOD keeps detail tolerances. Ansh (Phase 4): bottom cap lifted off so the electronics show on the mat.
